lines.1: Fourth period ended, and lunch break began.
lines.3: The afternoon classes felt like a bit of a chore.
lines.11: 「You won't even look me in the eye. Coward.」
lines.13: I let my silence answer for me.
lines.15: She spat the words at me.
lines.16: 「And you're off on your own again?」
lines.17: 「Huh? I just happen to be alone right now.」
lines.23: 「Still spoiling for a fight, I see.」
lines.25: It had been a long time since we'd exchanged words.
lines.26: But if this was how it went, not talking like usual was far better.
lines.29: On the bright side, I was truly glad we hadn't ended up in the same class.
lines.30: Konoe served as a valuable warning to me.
lines.31: Nothing good came of letting myself get swept up in the excitement.
